summary: Copa Holdings, S.A. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting preliminary monthly traffic statistics for September 2026. Consolidated capacity (ASMs) rose 15.7% year over year to 3,041.0 million, while revenue passenger miles (RPMs) increased 17.1% to 2,674.4 million, lifting system load factor to 87.9%, up 1.1 percentage points from September 2025. The filing is a routine operational disclosure by the Panama-domiciled, NYSE-listed carrier; no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or structural mechanics are stated, and no deal terms apply.
